confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors use Rovaniemi's October 2026 city averages; cocktail and wine estimates use current local menu checks and are positioned against local draft beer prices. comparable_city_reasoning: Local Rovaniemi prices are the basis; accommodation reflects general Finnish Lapland tourist-center costs and winter demand rather than a single comparable city.
